questions.chapter: Robot Anatomy, Coordinate Frames & Homogeneous Transformations
questions.text: Explain Robot Anatomy: Links, Joints (Revolute, Prismatic), Degrees of Freedom (DoF), Work Envelope, and Configurations (Cartesian, Cylindrical, Spherical, SCARA, Articulated). Derive the $4 \times 4$ Homogeneous Transformation Matrix for composite translation and rotation.

questions.chapter: Forward & Inverse Kinematics (Denavit-Hartenberg / D-H Parameters)
questions.text: State the Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) convention rules. Derive the generic D-H Link Transformation Matrix $A_{i-1}^i = \text{Rot}(z, \theta_i) \text{Trans}(z, d_i) \text{Trans}(x, a_i) \text{Rot}(x, \alpha_i)$. Establish the D-H parameter table and determine the Forward Kinematic Transformation matrix for a 3-DoF Planar Revolute Robotic Arm (RRR).

questions.chapter: Forward & Inverse Kinematics (Denavit-Hartenberg / D-H Parameters)
questions.text: Explain Inverse Kinematics. Solve the closed-form inverse kinematics of a 2-DoF planar robot arm using geometric / algebraic approach. Explain Pieper's solution for 6-DoF manipulators with spherical wrist.

questions.chapter: Robot Differential Motion, Jacobian & Singularity Analysis
questions.text: Define Robot Jacobian Matrix ($\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{J}(\mathbf{q})\dot{\mathbf{q}}$). Derive the Linear and Angular Velocity Jacobian for a 2-link planar manipulator. What are Kinematic Singularities (Boundary and Interior singularities)? What happens to end-effector dexterity and joint velocities near singularities?

questions.chapter: Robot Dynamics (Euler-Lagrange & Newton-Euler Formulations)
questions.text: Derive the equations of motion for a 2-DoF planar robot manipulator using the Euler-Lagrange Formulation: $\frac{d}{dt}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}_i}\right) - \frac{\partial L}{\partial q_i} = \tau_i$ where $L = K - P$. Obtain the mass-inertia matrix $\mathbf{M}(\mathbf{q})$, Coriolis/centrifugal matrix $\mathbf{C}(\mathbf{q}, \dot{\mathbf{q}})$, and gravity vector $\mathbf{G}(\mathbf{q})$.

questions.chapter: Trajectory Planning, Sensors, Actuators & Robot Control
questions.text: Explain Trajectory Planning in joint space: (a) Cubic Polynomial trajectory with initial and final position and velocity constraints, and (b) Linear Segment with Parabolic Blends (LSPB).

questions.chapter: Trajectory Planning, Sensors, Actuators & Robot Control
questions.text: Explain Robot Actuators (DC motors, Brushless DC motors, Stepper motors, Hydraulic/Pneumatic actuators) and Sensors (Optical Encoders, Resolvers, IMU, LIDAR, Force/Torque sensors, Machine Vision). Explain Independent Joint PID Control and Computed Torque Control.
